<strong>Bellman lleva un descuento.</str: Bellman carries a discount. The $\gamma$ multiplies the future; forgetting it is the most frequent error in the reinforcement questions.
<strong>Cuenta parámetros con una fórmul: Count parameters with a formula, not by eye. A $3\times 3$ filter with 16 input channels and 32 output ones is $3\cdot 3\cdot 16\cdot 32 + 32$: write it out in full.
The softmax is checked by adding. If the attention weights do not add to 1, the normalisation is missing or there is one exponential too many.

A procedural exam with exercises from the whole block, with a clock and no hints, to find out whether you have understood what each architecture computes and not just what it is called.
Cuando en 2012 una red convolucional gan: When in 2012 a convolutional network won the ImageNet competition by an enormous margin, the test was an exam in the most literal sense: a million labelled images, one answer per image and a mark. Since then every architecture in this block has been measured in similar tests, and the exam here asks what you need to know to read those results: what each one computes and how much it costs.
